note: The Six Lines demo walkthrough: music and burned-in text, no voice. The plan is series/critic/demo/review-2.md (changed timeline, 8/10). Rendered by `node scripts/demo.mjs`. Beats are at the music's tempo. A live shot plays a take under public/ from `from` seconds at `rate`; `zoom` and `focus` (0 top, 1 bottom) crop into the phone screen, and `place` puts the text at the top or bottom.

from.how: mobile-mcp screen recording (simctl recordVideo failed with SimRenderServer error 2); variable frame rate, so converted with ffmpeg -vf fps=30,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -crf 16 for Remotion to seek it by time

take1.recorded: 2026-09-25, iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator (iOS 26.2), sixlines-ios b459a31f, Matrix skin, English (-appLanguage en). Question typed, 18 entered by hand with no changing lines, one real Gua interpretation, Wang Bi, What Would Prove This Wrong, a note saved.

take2.recorded: 2026-09-25, same session as take1: the saved reading opened from the Journal and scrolled so What Would Prove This Wrong sits in the upper half. In take1 it only reached the bottom edge.
